programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Fisherman's Dream"
programme.desc: Bed & breakfast owners receive feedback from their final guests of the season. Will weddings make or break a Spanish B&B, and can the Costa’s newest fisherman make his dream a reality?

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Dive into Marbella"
programme.desc: Can a family from North Yorkshire run a business in the middle of Europe’s only desert? A car enthusiast pushes to sell spares in France. Two expats launch a dive centre in Marbella.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Mexico"
programme.desc: Jonathan Legg is from California and he thinks he knows Mexican cuisine. This notion gets shattered as he experiences the onslaught of food in Mexico city! Between trying scorpion tacos and dodging shady markets in San Juan, he learns the dark art of sacred drinks, like pulque and mezcal, now turned into social libations. His journey also takes him to Oaxaca where he gets the low down on the fabled Mole sauce, and a long haul to a remote village reveals a secret ceremony that has origins of dark arts!

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - "Condo"
programme.desc: Downsizing can be a difficult transition & Jin’s objective is to make it as seamless as possible. In this episode, Jin’s client is moving from a house in Port Credit to a luxurious condo close to the downtown core.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - "King’s Obsession"
programme.desc: It is time to upsize! Daryl’s client is moving away from downtown Toronto because they desire a bigger space, more privacy, & tranquility.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S6 - "Beaufort, South Carolina"
programme.desc: Denella discovers that Beaufort is more than a hidden Lowcountry gem—it's a transformative destination that has charmed visitors since 1512.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "London"
programme.desc: James heads across the pond to discover what life for a blind traveler is like in a world capital like London.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "United Kingdom"
programme.desc: Escaping the hustle and bustle of the big city, James takes the train to visit the rest of England - proving the rest of England is more accessible than one might think.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Attempting to narrowboat the deepest canal lock in the UK"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 Attempting to narrowboat the deepest canal lock in the UK
programme.desc: The narrowboat journey faces its toughest test yet: navigating the deepest lock in the network while managing the daily difficulties of water life.

programme.title: A Simple Path: The Worldwide Ride
programme.desc: Skateboarding and its do it yourself lifestyle has permeated into the worlds of art, music, and fashion. The constant progression and search for the new, attracts unique individuals from all walks of life.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Skullbase"
programme.desc: The Walsh twins reveal why water safety crews and rescue teams are the unsung heroes of big wave surfing.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Impact Zone"
programme.desc: Francisco Porcella displays the unquenchable spirit that drives the desire to chase big waves.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "End of the Season"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 End of the Season
programme.desc: The best of the big wave surfing community wrap up an amazing El Nino season with the XXL Big Wave Awards in Anaheim, California.

programme.title: A Simple Path S1 - "Cape Town"
programme.desc: Cape Town South Africa is about vintage cameras, fish and chips with seals, botany inspired apparel, The Dollfins, a hand poke tattoo, forest foraged mushrooms and drag queens skating a barrier on Table mountain.

programme.title: A Simple Path S1 - "Johannesburg"
programme.desc: Empowered in Jozi the city of gold South Africa with the kids from Skateistan, leftfield artists and photographers, streetside Kotas, volcano sessions, Slappy screen printing, a backyard ramp and skating through an art gallery.

programme.title: A Simple Path S1 - "Botswana"
programme.desc: Gaborone, Botswana is the turf of The Knuckelheads and unlikely skate spots, True-D fashion, traditional feasts, garage beats, inspiring street art and a fashion shoot in an abandoned building.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "California Desert"
programme.desc: Lisa connects with a nomad poet, who literally helps her ‘climb’ out of her funk by scaling a challenging peak. After taking tea with a magician, Lisa meets a paramedic single mother hoping to imbue her daughter with valuable life experiences.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "California Coast"
programme.desc: After driving across the country, Lisa heads to Santa Monica to hang with a Hollywood producer and check out his pimped out Mercedes Benz G-Wagon. Lisa is welcomed into the school bus home of a family of 7! Because there is always room for one more.

programme.title: Street Art Challenge S1 - "Lisbon"
programme.desc: Two street artists are fusing their styles together in one of the world's finest cities, Lisbon.The challenge is left hanging by a thread when disaster strikes.

programme.title: Street Art Challenge S1 - "London"
programme.desc: Two legendary street artists team up in London for the ultimate Street Art Challenge. Things get out of hand between the two as it turns into a street fight.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Newfoundland"
programme.desc: Following Newfoundland’s rail history, Michael explores cod fishing, grape-free wine, and meadow cliffs by ATV.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Nova Scotia"
programme.desc: Exploring Canada’s railway roots, Michael discovers Nova Scotia through Indigenous dance, log rolling with a champion, and surfing iconic waves.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "New Brunswick"
programme.desc: Michael explores New Brunswick by land, sea, and air. He traverses historic bridges and scenic coasts before taking to the skies.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "London"
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx steps outside of her comfort zone to draw inspiration for her music track from urban youths in London’s Grime scene.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Amsterdam"
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx travels to Amsterdam to influence her music track and discovers it’s a whole lot more experimental than she imagined.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Paris"
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx travels to Paris, the city of love, for inspiration and discovers its diversity and a creative trend called retrofuture.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "LA"
programme.desc: In LA, we hike with wolfs, Ayurveda insights with Jay and a delicious meal from Karla. Marilia takes an adventurous leap from an airplane, showing the freedom in extreme sports.Tracy showcases the joy of pursuing passions with WCMX at the skate park.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Tokyo, Japan"
programme.desc: Vegas Bboy Ronnie is traveling to Japan to visit Bboy Shigekix in his hometown Tokyo. Shigekix will take Ronnie on an exciting Journey to show the Japanese culture and it's unique style of breaking and hip-hop.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Rotterdam, The Netherlands"
programme.desc: In the city of Rotterdam, three times world champion, Menno, hosts b-boy Junior from France. Both are considered legends. Menno takes Junior on a trip he will never forget and meet people who have all left their mark in the Dutch breaking community.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "NYC, USA"
programme.desc: Four BC One World Final legends from our series, Ronnie, Neguin, Junior and Shigekix, are coming to NYC. These legends will meet some of the future legends taking part in this year’s world final and take them on a journey through hip hop history.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Taiwan: The Southern Tribes"
programme.sub-title: S06 : E09 Taiwan: The Southern Tribes
programme.desc: Heading off the tourist trail in southern Taiwan, Jonathan embeds with the indigenous Paiwan tribe to uncover a hidden World War II story.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Season Special: Behind the Scenes"
programme.sub-title: S06 : E10 Season Special: Behind the Scenes
programme.desc: An exclusive look behind the scenes of the season, featuring memorable milestones and never-before-seen un-aired segments from the road.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "The Wilds of Western Canada and the Territories"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E18 The Wilds of Western Canada and the Territories
programme.desc: Discover the wilds of the West, from the glass skyscrapers of Vancouver to the massive, snow-capped majestic peaks of Banff National Park.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "The Coolest Endurance Races"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 The Coolest Endurance Races
programme.desc: Travel the globe to witness the world's most grueling competitions and meet the intense athletes brave enough to tackle these punishing races.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Tofu"
programme.desc: Discover the delicious and nutritious world of tofu with Lauren as she experiments with various textures and flavors, pushing the soybean to its limits to create amazing dishes like Scramble tofu and the sweet-spicy delight of Tahu Gejrot.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Mushroom"
programme.desc: Lauren dives into the fascinating world of mushrooms, exploring their flavors, textures, and health benefits. She shows how to make savory mushroom sausage rolls and delicious mushroom steaks, showcasing the versatility of these earthy ingredients.

programme.title: Streetfood Nomad: Kolkata S1 - "The Street Scene"
programme.desc: Kolkata’s extraordinary street-food scene has been influenced by its various conquerors and rulers. The most profound influence has been from the fabulously rich and powerful Mughals. Will reimagines classic dishes while also incorporating the unique street food flavours he encounters.

programme.title: Streetfood Nomad: Kolkata S1 - "Fuelling the Workforce"
programme.desc: The city of Kolkata is one of the most densely populated in the world. That’s a lot of mouths to feed. Fortunately, it’s a place that knows just how to do it. Fuelled by the bustling energy of street vendors, Will seeks inspiration from Indian working man's essentials.

programme.title: Inside the Box with Jack Stein S1 - "Zagreb"
programme.desc: In landlocked Zagreb, Jack swaps potatoes for sauerkraut to serve a localized fish and chips to curious locals and government officials.

programme.title: Inside the Box with Jack Stein S1 - "Darwin"
programme.desc: With no shrimp in Darwin, Jack pivots to mudcrab and crocodile meat to reinvent his Cornwall recipe for a tropical Australian crowd.

programme.title: Inside the Box with Jack Stein S1 - "Bangkok"
programme.desc: Jack dives into the chaotic, aromatic world of Thailand's street food capital to see who can balance the ultimate sweet and sour flavors.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "New York"
programme.desc: Rapper Shiniqua, aka Pretty Little Monster, juggles motherhood while trying to avoid the trappings of Instagram fame. Her passion is writing rap lyrics and always tries to keep it real.

programme.title: Andy & Ben Eat Australia S2 - "Cape Grim"
programme.desc: Andy leaves Three Blue Ducks to join Benny in Tasmania.Rain swaps abalone diving for Cape Grim beef,ending with a visit to Burnie's Produce for the People.

programme.title: Andy & Ben Eat Australia S2 - "Abalone Time"
programme.desc: Rain clears for an abalone dive and boat feast before Andy and Benny head to Hobart,touring Ben's new restaurant and dining at Small Fry and Franklin.

programme.title: Andy & Ben Eat Australia S2 - "The Island & The Wallaby"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 The Island & The Wallaby
programme.desc: Andy & Ben explore Bruny Island, forage native foods, cook wallaby over fire, hunt at night, then wrap up Tasmania with a tomahawk feast.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "Korea"
programme.desc: Karena and Kasey land in Seoul to master Korean BBQ, study with a Kimchi Master, and cook Kiwi-Korean fusion for a panel of elite local foodies.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "Italy"
programme.desc: Karena and Kasey master Roman pasta and tripe while honoring their Māori heritage and fallen soldiers at the historic Monte Cassino battlegrounds.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "India"
programme.desc: Karena and Kasey face a sensory explosion in Old Delhi's streets, feed thousands at a Sikh temple, and prep appetizers for a massive Indian wedding.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "India: Can Kolkata be considered a foodie destination of India?"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 India: Can Kolkata be considered a foodie destination of India?
programme.desc: Liesel pinballs around a city known for its gastronomy, the forgotten hub of British East India trading company, Kolkata. From trying out what the bustling city’s vibrant street food scene has to offer, to the lesser known gems, including, venturing into India’s only Chinatown and sampling their delicacies. A tale of walking food tours, hole in the wall joints serving up North Eastern dumplings, messy fish markets, and of course, the pride of Bengal, the Hilsa fish. Is Kolkata up to par with the other major metropolitan cities of India? This episode finds out exactly that!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Nevada: What else is there in Nevada for foodies besides Vegas?"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Nevada: What else is there in Nevada for foodies besides Vegas?
programme.desc: This investigative mission starts off in the sin city atmosphere of the Vegas strip. After a gluttonous stint at a generic buffet, Liesel is inspired to do a road trip to find iconic gems in the state of Nevada. From ghost towns, to monstrous foodie challenges, to hole in the wall dive bars in the middle of nowhere, this trip has it all. Liesel finds the resurgence of Basque cuisine in Northern Nevada, and learns that Reno can do fine dining as well! A trip to Virginia city also reveals that the Silver State has some haunted bars where patrons from the 1800s are rumored to be still imbibing and spooking locals! It’s a road trip in every sense of the word!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Rome: What are the tourists missing out on?"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Rome: What are the tourists missing out on?
programme.desc: Italy is a vacationer’s paradise. The food, the people, the sights and sounds, the history! But are the tourists doing it right when it comes to the trying out authentic food in Rome? Liesel embarks on a mission to explore the street food of the city. With the help of her food journalist buddy, Saverio de Luca, Liesel sifts through pasticceri, food festivals, touristed hotspots, all in an effort to understand real Roman food.

programme.title: Foodie Adventures with Ash Pollard S1 - "Fiji"
programme.desc: Vibrant Fijian ingredients lead Ash to learn from local and international chefs before hosting commentator Steve Price for dinner.

programme.title: Foodie Adventures with Ash Pollard S1 - "Monaco"
programme.desc: Exploring the culinary hideaways of Monaco gives Ash new inspiration to serve a high-end menu back home to guest Kris Smith.

programme.title: Foodie Adventures with Ash Pollard S1 - "Italy - Northern Secrets"
programme.desc: Rustic regional dishes and northern Italian villages entice Ash, who later prepares a feast for comedian Nazeem Hussain.

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - "How to Order Chinese Food"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 How to Order Chinese Food
programme.desc: In this episode, hosts Tianran and Eva will give you a crash course on everything from choosing the right restaurant, to pairing dishes according to color, aroma, taste and form, so that at the end, you too can feast your friends like a pro.

programme.title: Outpost In Morocco
programme.desc: George Raft, Mary Windsor, and Akim Tamiroff star in this romantic drama from director Robert Florey (The Florentine Dagger, Daughter of Shanghai). Raft plays Capt. Gerard, a member of the Foreign Legion known for his romantic entanglements. He's assigned to escort an emir's daughter to her father's mountain citadel and learn about the emir's activities. Not surprisingly, Gerard finds trouble brewing! With footage shot in Morocco, this movie also features a beautiful musical score by twotime Oscar nominee Michel Michelet (Voice in the Wind).

programme.title: Between Men
programme.desc: When his young son is shot, John Wellington kills the culprit and flees. But his son Johnny recovers and is raised by Sir George. Some twenty years later Johnny sets out to find Sir George's missing granddaughter. He finds her and also finds Rand, but neither of the two men realize they are father and son.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead!

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Stagecoach to Denver
programme.desc: Ride the outlaws' highway! Allan Rocky Lane stars as Red Ryder, shootin' and fightin' his way to justice in this old slugfest from Republic Pictures. This time he's a stagecoach driver battling a crooked land commissioner and his cohorts, including a sheriff on the take. Robert Blake costars as Little Beaver!

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: Law of the Pampas
programme.desc: Murder below the Equator...and Hopalong Cassidy races to action in the heart of the wild Pampas country !Hoppy (William Boyd) and his pal Lucky (Russell Hayden) head to South America to look after a herd of cattle sold by Cassidy's boss to an Argentine rancher. Unfortunately, the scoundrel Ralph Merritt (Sidney Blackmer) wants the cattle, and he's not above hiring some dangerous characters to do his dirty work. It's a test of blazing guns...under a blazing sun! Can the boys of Bar 20 lay down the law in a lawless place like the Pampas? Can Hoppy and his gang succeed in what is truly a last frontier? Watch and see!

Without his usualy partner, Matt enlists the help of Captain Harry Love. Starring Jim Davis, Mary Castle, and Robert Anderson. Look for Rick Jason as Murietta. Jason would later go on to star in the popular ABC war series Combat!

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Following the murder of a railroad agent, Matt and Frankie work to bring the vengeful Tiburcio Vasquez to justice. Starring Jim Davis, mary Castle,Anthony Caruso, Edward Colmas, Lillian Molieri, and Eddie Parker. Also, look for Glenn Strange as Sheriff Billy Rowland. Strange was known for playing Frankenstein's monster in several Universal pictures, as well as a recurring role on Gunsmoke. Also, Eddie Parker, who plays a trapper in this episode, was one of Hollywood's most revered stuntmen. Directed by William Witney. Epsiode oringinally aired in 1954.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Jim Davis stars as Matt Clark, a railroad detective who chases outlaws preying on the railroads of the west. In this episode he has to deal with the legendary Chief Crazy Horse (George Keymas) Also starring Mary Castle, Chubby Johnson, John Holland, and Alma Beltran. Directed by William Witney. Episode originally aired in 1954.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detectives Matt and Frankie track down Black Bart, a famous criminal responsible for a string of stage coach robberies. .Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle.Also starring Arthur Space, Sammy Ogg, Marc Hamilton, Frank Sully, and I. StanfordJjolly. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954. Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White.Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben and Adam are in jail, about to be hung for a crime they didn't commit. Joe and Hoss must find out why the witnesses to the alleged crime have lied about what happened before the execution takes place. They receive help from a vagrant named Lassiter who is looking for the men who committed a lynching in Kansas years ago.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The son of a neighboring rancher intends to sell their land for a mining operation that will ruin the water rights agreement that Andy and Ben made years ago. Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Cartwrights take a young boy to the Ponderosa after the death of his mother. Hoss is the only one that is able to get through the boy's hostility and bitterness, but, as the two begin to get close, the boy's father breaks out of prison and comes to retrieve the boy.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Little Joe Cartwright tries to help a gypsy girl who was abandoned by her people - because they believed she was a werewolf.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Yodelin' Kid from Pine Ridge
programme.desc: Cowboy icon Gene Autry is framed for murder in this tale of warring cattlemen and turpentiners. The music driven western from director Joseph Kane (Flame of Barbary Coast) includes such familiar faces as Smiley Burnette, Charles Middleton, and Betty Bronson. In between gunshots you'll hear plenty of traditional cowboy songs, including She'll Be Coming 'Round The Mountain, and Red River Valley, plus Gene's version of Sing Me a Song of the Saddle.

programme.title: Frontier Justice
programme.desc: Hoot Gibson is back! But he never imagined he'd find his father in an insane asylum and his cattle ranch overrun with sheep! Worst of all, Roger Williams stars as the diabolical James WIlton, a rival who isn't above murder. For trivia buffs: Director Robert F. McGowan was the man behind several of the classic Our Gang comedies...

programme.title: Young Buffalo Bill
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars in this highly fictionalized account of Bill Cody's life from director Joseph Kane (Dakota, Flame of Barbary Coast). What it lacks in accuracy is made up for with adventure, as well as and some of Roy's great cowboy songs, including 'Blow Breeze Blow', and 'Rollin' Down to Santa Fe'. Other stars include George 'Gabby' Hayes, Chief Thundercloud, and the lovely Pauline Moore (Young Mr. Lincoln, Charlie Chan at Treasure Island)

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: A big time cast, including Randolph Scott, Buster Crabbe, Barton MacLane, and Harry Carey star in this feature about stampedes, Indian attacks, and plundering thieves! Directed by the esteemed Henry Hathaway (True Grit, Niagara).

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of his henchmen deliver guns across the border to a corrupt Mexican general who is bent on overtaking the province by force. When Griffin then demands that the general now fulfill his part of the bargain, the general orders him killed, unaware that his lieutenant, Sanchez is in Griffins employ. Rather than killing Griffin, Sanchez shoots the general, and after promoting himself to the post, promises Griffin that he will cross the border in time for April Morning. When O.J. is found murdered, Apache questions Maude, who reveals that O.J. traveled to a Mexican cantina monthly. Apache then rides to the cantina, where he is met by a cavalry patrol led by Sgt. ORourke. Upon learning that the cantina owner has recently been killed, Apache demands that the mans widow, Rosita, take him to Rodriguez, her husbands employer. Rosita then introduces Apache to a Mexican sergeant who allegedly knows where Rodriguez can be found. Unaware that the sergeant is Rodriguez disguised as a soldier, Apache follows him to a church where the priest claims that Rodriguez has claimed sanctuary and is therefore immune to the law.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Ted Hayden, a tough hombre who goes undercover to join a gang led by a heartless fiend known only as Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock). Gentry is out to take over a ranch belonging to one of Hayden's friends, but as Hayden finds out, Gentry has a lot more than that up his sleeve. You'll have to watch this two-fisted Western to find out the rest!

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: Lost Canyon
programme.desc: When Johnny Travers (Jay Kirby) is falsely accused of robbing a bank, it's up to Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) to clear his name and find the real villains. There's nothing better than watching Hoppy get rough with the rustlers, and it's all the better when you get to hear the Sportsmen Quartette sing (I got Spurs) Jingle, Jangle, Jingle.

programme.title: The Kansan
programme.desc: Richard Dix stars in this epic of the boisterous and brawling Old West! Wounded in a gun battle with the notorious James gang, John Bonniwell (Dix) wakes up in the hospital to find out hes been elected marshal! He quickly learns that this hot-headed frontier town can only be cooled off with blazing lead and dynamite! Jane Wyatt, Albert Dekker, Victor Jory, and Robert Armstrong also star in this tale of smashing fists and crashing bullets from director George Archainbaud (The Lost Squadron).

programme.title: Bulldog Courage
programme.desc: Tim McCoy, one of the unsung heroes of 1930s western pictures, stars in a dual role. First, hes Slim Braddock, a miner who turns to robbing stagecoaches after being swindled by a banker. When Slim is murdered, his son Tim, also played by McCoy, seeks vengeance. Directed by B-movie legend Sam Newfield for Excelsior Pictures, this film is a showcase for McCoy, who appeared in more than 90 movies and in 1960 earned a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Roll, Thunder, Roll!
programme.desc: Red Ryder finds two silver conchas, the trademark of bandit El Conejo, at a raided ranch. He reports the raid to Marshal Bill Faugh but tells him that he suspects that El Conejo, a Robin Hood type character, is being framed.

programme.title: Hit the Saddle
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers get involved when a local sheriff is killed in this B-western from Republic Pictures. The trouble starts when a villainous rancher (J.P. McGowan) plots to steal some government protected horses. Bob Livingstone, Max Terhune, and Ray Corrigan star as the gallant Mesquiteers, while a young Rita Hayworth (Gilda, The Lady From Shanghai) appears as a sexy saloon singer who turns a Mesquiteer's head.

programme.title: Hellgate (Edited Version)
programme.desc: In 1867 Kansas, veterinarian Sterling Hayden treats an injured stranger who turns out to have been a guerrilla raider--and Hayden soon finds himself serving a term in one of the world's most terrifying prisons under sadistic commandant Ward Bond. Adapted from the story of Dr. Mudd, the physician who attended John Wilkes Booth, assassin of President Lincoln.

Series won an Emmy in 1955 .(This episode also features Kristine Miller, who would become a semi-regular in the series.)

Series won an Emmy in 1955.

Directed by William Witney. Episode originally aired in 1954. Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans

Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.desc: Hawkeye is accused of the crimes committed by Ethan Allan and the Green Mountain boys. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.desc: A town starts to believe they are being cursed by a witch after a series of strange occurences. Hawkeye: John Hart. programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook help a Medicine Man who has been driven out of his tribe. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Way of the West
programme.desc: Government agent Gordon (Hal Taliaferro) goes undercover to investigate an ongoing war between cattlemen and sheepmen. But he soon finds himself framed for murder! This low budget western from the short-lived Empire Pictures is from the golden era of shoot em ups, when audiences knew who the bad guys were, and couldnt wait for the good guys to serve up some just punishment!

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: Kurt Neumann (The Fly, Rocketship X-M) directed this bawdy tale of a love that was louder than war drums! With a cast that includes Scott Brady, Rita Gam, and Neville Brand, the story takes place on a remote army post where an artist romances a trio of women, just as a vengeful settler turns the army and the local Iroquois tribe against each other. Film buffs might like to know that the cinematography for this feature is by four-time Oscar nominee Karl Struss, who won an Academy Award in 1929 for his work on Sunrise.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent!

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead!

programme.title: Idaho
programme.desc: Western icon Roy Rogers, along with his trusty companion Trigger, are back for another adventure. This time, a respected judge is being framed for murder by a crooked saloon owner. Always the valiant champion, Rogers vows to clear the name of the judge and find the truth all while courting a lovely beau. Cellist turned editor turned Republic Pictures workhorse Joseph Kane takes the reins of this rousing, musical adventure, which features a number of original songs performed by Rogers himself, with the help of singer-songwriter Bob Nolan and character actor Smiley Burnette (TVs Petticoat Junction).

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila O'Conner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Rawhide Rangers
programme.desc: Blackie's gang is creating havoc and the Ranger, Brand Calhoun and his brother go to investigate.

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: Ads for this Roy Rogers classic roared HEAD FOR THE MUSICAL HILLS...ROY IS GUNNIN' FOR THRILLS! And thrills are what you'll get when you watch this fun, action packed B-Western from Republic Pictures. There's some great comic relief from Andy Devine and Chester Conklin, two of Hollywood's all-time greats. This old-fashioned shoot-'em-up was directed by William Witney, who would go on to direct many of television's top western sagas, including Bonanza, Wagon Train, and The Wild, Wild West.

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures. All of the old jokes about cowboys kissing their horse may have started with this very movie, as it focuses on Roys loving relationship with Trigger, the greatest horse in all of Hollywood. The film also features Roys beloved Dale Evans, plus, adding some country swing to the musical numbers is Roys favorite backing band, the Sons of the Pioneers! Songs include Ole Faithful, Long, Long Ago and Livin Western Style.

programme.title: Boots and Saddles
programme.desc: When a young Englishman inherits a ranch, none other than Gene Autry takes up the challenge of turning the Brit into a real westerner. He convinces the Brit to use the ranch to raise horses, but things quickly grow complicated. Look for the usual cast of characters from Republic Pictures, including Smiley Burnette (as the irresistible Frog Millhouse!). Songs include Take Me Back To My Boots and Saddle, and Ridin the Range.

programme.title: Arizona Bound
programme.desc: The Rough Riders are called upon to help save a stagecoach line. From 1941, starring Buck Jones and Tim McCoy, plus Horace Murphy and Luana Walters. Directed by Spencer Bennett.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? And how many songs will he get to sing? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws!

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: Susan Hayward stars in this dramatic tale of the Oklahoma oil boom. She plays Cherokee Lansing, a determined young woman out to protect her father's honor after he's killed by men from a competing oil company. With a cast that includes Robert Preston, Ed Begley, and Pedro Armendariz, this engaging picture from producer Walter Wanger (Cleopatra, I Want to Live!) was nominated for an Academy Award in the Special Effects category. Also, listen for veteran character actor Chill Wills as the narrator!

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Roy Rogers's beloved horse Trigger is stolen and held for ransom money. Will Roy find $100,000 to get his faithful companion back, or will he find a way to trap the gang holding the horse hostage? Along with Roy and Trigger, you'll find Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher, and young Michael Chapin as Ted Carver, a gallant boy who helps reunite Roy with the smartest horse in show business!

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Red's aunt, the Duchess, knew Steve's father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: In Old Colorado
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy and his crew get involved in a war over water rights in this feature from Harry Sherman Productions and Paramount Pictures. The intrigue starts when crafty Joe Weller (Morris Ankrum) turns two ranchers against each other, which leads to dire results. This is the 33rd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy movies, with WIlliam Boyd in the role he made famous. Also, look for regular Hoppy co-stars Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Andy Clyde as California Carson.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy Barcroft. Directed by Goerge Archainbaud.

programme.title: Pick a Puppy
programme.desc: Watch smaller, cute-and-cuddly breeds win over a dad who loves macho dogs.

programme.title: Pick a Puppy
programme.desc: Check out outdoorsy Aussies, Labs, and petit griffons with three excited girls.

programme.title: Pick a Puppy

programme.title: The Main Guard of Valletta
programme.desc: This feature explores the story of the Main Guard building in St George’s Square, Valletta, through the research and investigations carried out ahead of its restoration. It reveals discoveries about the building’s history and the various plans proposed for it over the years, including a period when its very survival was uncertain. The feature shows how research undertaken before restoration can uncover important chapters in the history of a landmark building.

programme.desc: Naples is Italy in the extreme. We’ll prowl backstreet fish markets and dodge speedy Vespas before indulging in pizza where it was invented. Afterward, we'll climb to the top of nearby Mount Vesuvius, then wander through the ruins of Pompeii, the Roman town it destroyed.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Andalucia
programme.desc: Join Angelica Malini on an unforgettable journey through Andalucía, southern Spain’s most colorful and captivating region, as they explore Cordoba and Cadiz. Famous for flamenco, tapas, and stunning Moorish architecture, Andalucía’s rich history comes alive here. In Cordoba, the host marvels at the breathtaking Mezquita, a grand mosque turned cathedral. In Cadiz, an ancient Phoenician city, they soak in sweeping Atlantic views and a corniche with hints of North Africa. This episode immerses viewers in the culture, history, and vibrant spirit of one of Spain’s most enchanting regions.

programme.title: La Padova dei Da Carrara
programme.desc: Discover Padua’s shift from medieval municipality to the Da Carrara lordship, featuring the Scrovegni Chapel, Carrarese Palace, and the works of Giotto, Petrarch, and Donatello. It explores the city’s university, its ties with Venice, rivalry with Verona, and the legacy of the Da Carrara family. Olympic champion Novella Calligaris offers a modern voice for Padua.

programme.desc: A heartfelt musical tribute to Malta, celebrating the island’s distinctive character, cultural heritage and enduring connection with its people. Set against the backdrop of the Mediterranean, this music video captures the beauty, spirit and identity of the Maltese Island.

programme.title: Gold Cuisine
programme.desc: The spotlight falls on two traditional Cypriot favorites. First, we explore the art of preparing Oven Lamb Kleftiko, a slow-cooked dish where tender lamb is infused with herbs and baked to perfection, capturing the essence of village cooking. Then, the journey continues with Kattimeria, fried sweet flatbreads that balance crisp texture with a hint of indulgent sweetness. Together, these recipes showcase the comforting richness and variety of Cyprus’s culinary heritage.

programme.title: Med Nations 05 Morocco
programme.desc: Morocco! The bridge between Africa and the Mediterranean. Morocco's lively markets, delicious foods, and long-standing traditions show how trade, travellers, and different cultures have shaped the country over the years.

programme.title: Med Minds 10 Julius Caesar
programme.desc: Julius Caesar, the formidable leader of ancient Rome, became a lasting symbol of ambition, power, and transformation, shaping the destiny of the Mediterranean world through conquest, vision, and a legacy that endures beyond his dramatic fall.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.sub-title: S06:E03 Dubrovnik and Balkan Side Trips
programme.desc: Exploring Croatia, Montenegro, and Bosnia, we’ll get to know the three major groups of the former Yugoslavia, Croats, Serbs, and Bosniaks, before enjoying a bit of fun in the sun along the Adriatic in Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Marseille
programme.desc: Malini Angelica travels to Marseille, France’s vibrant Mediterranean port city. She explores its historic Old Port, colorful neighborhoods, and bustling markets, discovering the city’s unique blend of French and North African influences. From sampling local dishes like bouillabaisse to soaking in seaside views and street art, Malini uncovers what makes Marseille one of France’s most dynamic and diverse cities.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: For four years, a dedicated team of filmmakers, scientists, and experts explored the Mediterraneo, capturing breathtaking moments where nature and humanity collide. This powerful documentary reveals stunning images of the sea’s beauty and the urgent struggle to protect it, offering a moving portrait of our relationship with nature.

programme.title: Dates that made History
programme.sub-title: S01:E01 399 BC The Trial Of Socrates
programme.desc: 399 BC: The Trial of Socrates dramatises the famous trial of the Greek philosopher Socrates, who is charged with corrupting the youth and impiety. The episode delves into Socrates' defence, his philosophical ideas, and his unwavering commitment to his principles. It explores the tension between individual thought and the societal norms of ancient Athens. Through this trial, the show examines the impact of Socrates' ideas on Western philosophy and his legacy.

programme.title: Mediterranean Yoga Release Stress from the Body
programme.sub-title: Mediterranean Yoga Release Stress from the Body
programme.desc: Mediterranean Yoga is a series that blends Embodiment Yoga with the peaceful beauty of the Mediterranean. Set in stunning coastal and natural locations, each episode encourages viewers to reconnect mind and body through gentle movement, breathwork, and mindfulness in a safe and calming space.

programme.title: Isabella Turso Sliding Doors
programme.desc: An Original Music Video by Isabella Turso

programme.title: The Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Dive into the shadowy world of Hades, god of the Underworld. Ruler of the dead, Hades is both feared and misunderstood, embodying the final destination of all mortals. His myth reveals a realm governed not by cruelty, but by order, fate, and the inevitability of death.

programme.title: Madame Butterfly Teatro Alla Scala 2016
programme.desc: In Madama Butterfly (Teatro alla Scala, 2016), a young Japanese woman enters into a marriage with an American naval officer, filled with hope for a new life. As time passes, the contrast between her expectations and reality becomes more profound. The opera unfolds with deep emotional intensity, leading to a powerful and poignant conclusion.

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: Bay Area Godfathers II
programme.desc: Info not available

programme.title: For Metalheads Only
programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Finnish Metal Special
programme.desc: From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

programme.title: Folk Metal Forest Feast
programme.desc: Raise your horns and join the battle! A high-energy mix of crushing metal riffs, accordion melodies, and epic pagan chants. Step into the ancient woods for a wild night of acoustic tradition meets heavy metal fury.

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Thrash Metal Attack
programme.desc: Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

programme.title: The Home of Heavy
programme.desc: Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

programme.title: Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

programme.title: Together We Rise
programme.desc: A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts Part 2
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E39 De Smurfen: De Smurf Fontein
programme.desc: De Smurfen ontdekken “de fontein der jeugd”. Deze wordt echter bewaakt door een boosaardige trol die het magische boek van Grote Smurf weet te stelen. Ze kunnen Gargamel overtuigen hen te helpen, maar de slechterik valt in handen van de trol.

programme.desc: De boosaardige tovenaar Gargamel vraagt zijn collega Balthazar een recept om de Smurfen te vangen. Het omvat het ontvoeren van Moeder Natuur om de komst van de lente te verhinderen. Gelukkig schieten de Smurfen te hulp.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E41 De Smurfen: De Goeie,de Kwaaie,de Smurfse
programme.desc: Koning Argon is een gespierde, lompe bruut, maar zijn tovenaar Mordain is nog erger. Hij heeft plannen om verschillende Smurfen die hij gevangen heeft genomen te gebruiken om al het goud van de koning te stelen...

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E42 De Smurfen: Zuster Smurf
programme.desc: Smurfin heeft een nieuw vriendinnetje, Laura, een zesjarig meisje dat samen met haar ouders aan de rand van het woud woont. Samen gaan de 2 meisjes op stap in het bos. Maar een oude heks krijgt hen te pakken.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E43 De Smurfen: Smulpap Smulsmurf
programme.desc: Gulzige Smurf overdrijft het. Hij wordt steeds zwaarder en zwaarder, totdat zijn gewicht hem in gevaar brengt. De gemene Gargamel is van plan om hem te vangen... Kan Gulzige Smurf gered worden door Grote Smurf?

programme.title: De Smurfen

programme.desc: Oogsten en eten maken neemt veel tijd in beslag voor de Smurfen. Maar Knutsel heeft een machine uitgevonden die dit allemaal zal oplossen. Jammer genoeg zijn er ook nadelen verbonden aan deze prachtige uitvinding …

programme.desc: Het is een grote eer voor een Smurf om gevraagd te worden om naar het Moeras te gaan en het zeldzame paddestoel terug te brengen. Maar Bange Smurf aarzelt om de Moerasmonster onder ogen te komen, dus stuurt hij de Smurf die geen nee kan zeggen.

Het is namelijk een tijdje geleden. Eve heeft het de afgelopen maanden iets rustiger gehad. Britt laat jullie zien hoe ze het rijden weer oppakt met Eve.

Ze wordt vandaag geschoren en Britt is benieuwd welke kleur nu tevoorschijn komt. Ze zijn helemaal klaar voor de make-over dag. Wat vinden jullie van de nieuwe looks?

programme.desc: Naranjina steekt haar hoofd uit een putdeksel en wordt bijna door een auto overreden die flyers rondstrooit van de grote goochelaar Mantresse… Naranjina kan maar net op tijd haar hoofd intrekken… Snel kruist ze op de plattegrond die ze aan het tekenen is aan dat deze put op een weg uitkomt.

programme.desc: Het regent fel. De kinderen zitten in de klas en krijgen les over de regenboog. Plots verschijnt er een in de lucht, en achter de niets vermoedende juf sluipen de kinderen naar buiten. Ze slagen er zelfs in om de regenboog te beklimmen.

Zij denkt namelijk dat er suikerspinnen in de doos zitten.

Maar groot blijkt ook niet alles als een kleine muis te groot wordt om nog in haar huisje te kunnen en haar baby’s eten te geven. Gelukkig is Mac mee om te helpen.

programme.title: Chloe's Toverkast

programme.desc: Chloe en Jet komen in dinosaurusland en helpen een dino met het zoeken naar het ei waar zijn kleine zusje in zit.

programme.title: Chloe's Toverkast
programme.desc: Chloe en Tara zijn super gelukkig als ze eindelijk de Tandenfee mogen ontmoeten. Maar de tandenfee is haar tovertasje kwijt waarin alle cadeautjes zitten die de kinderen onder hun kussen krijgen als ze een tand hebben gewisseld. Chloe en Tara helpen de Tandenfee haar muntenbuidel terug te vinden.

programme.title: Chloe's Toverkast

programme.desc: Chloe en haar vriendjes worden kunstenaars. Ze schilderen prachtige plaatjes die tot leven komen maar vergeten hun vriendje tien vingers te geven zodat hij met hen mee kan gaan fietsen.

programme.title: Chloe's Toverkast

programme.desc: Chloe en vriendjes reizen af naar de Mexicaanse jungle om 'Indiana Jones' te spelen. Ze ontmoeten een toekan en met de hulp van een aap lossen ze een puzzel op en helpen ze een ei terugvinden.

programme.title: Chloe's Toverkast
programme.desc: Vandaag gaan Chloe en haar vriendjes skiën. Ze ontmoeten Scout, een st. Bernardpuppy die heel goed is in dingen vinden, maar de weg naar huis kwijt is. Chloe, Jet en Tara hebben de perfecte oplossing en helpen hem de weg naar huis terug te vinden.

programme.title: Chloe's Toverkast
programme.sub-title: S01 : E28 Chloe's Toverkast: Laat ’t maar aan de bevers over
programme.desc: Chloe en Riley zijn in deze aflevering boswachters. Een rivier door het bos is helemaal droog geworden en hierdoor kunnen de bosdieren en hun vriendjes niet meer drinken. Chloe lost het mysterie op.

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter
programme.sub-title: S05 : E10 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter: Het huwelijk
programme.desc: Het nichtje van de boswachter gaat trouwen en Bobbie heeft de ring kwijtgemaakt. Het duurt nog een paar uur voordat het huwelijk begint, maar de ring moet natuurlijk op tijd terug zijn. Hoe gaan ze dit nu weer oplossen?

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter
programme.sub-title: S05 : E11 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter: Kabouters
programme.desc: Ernst en Bobbie vinden kaboutersporen in het bos. De boswachter wil de kabouters vangen| maar Ernst en Bobbie vinden dat zielig en gaan de kabouters redden.

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter
programme.sub-title: S05 : E12 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij de boswachter: Motorcrossers
programme.desc: Tijdens het broedseizoen rijden er motorcrossers door het bos. Ernst en Bobbie willen ervoor zorgen dat de crossers uit het bos verdwijnen en verzinnen een list om ze te achtervolgen.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.sub-title: S01 : E37 Mouk: Kleine Visjes Worden Groot
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa vertellen hun avontuur in Griekenland waar ze babyvisjes helpen terugzetten in het water waar ze geboren werden.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa zijn in het besneeuwde Canada, en helpen Abbie bij het oogsten van de ahornsiroop.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 Mouk: Leve de piñata!
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa vertellen Popo en Mita hoe een verjaardag in Mexico gevierd wordt. Met een piñata natuurlijk!

programme.title: Mouk
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Mouk: OEPS, bus gemist!
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa vertellen hun avontuur in Peru, waar ze de bus naar de top van de berg hadden gemist en die rijdend op een ezel probeerden in te halen.

programme.title: De Snorkels
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 De Snorkels aflevering 12 A/B
programme.desc: Wanneer Dimmy de bal mist voor het winnende touchdown, overtuigt Daffney hem om zich bij haar balletles aan te sluiten om zijn behendigheid te vergroten.

programme.title: De Snorkels
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 De Snorkels aflevering 13 A/B
programme.desc: Occy wordt aangesteld als bewaker van Allstar's nieuwe kelpplukuitvinding. De avond voor het wedstrijd voor Koning van het Kelp, weet Junior Occarina over te halen om Occy weg te lokken, zodat hij de machine kan saboteren.

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest: De Verjaardag van Ernst
programme.desc: Liveshow van Ernst en Bobbie waarin de verjaardag van Ernst wordt gevierd. Alleen...zijn kado wordt gestolen!

programme.title: Troetelbeertjes

programme.title: Troetelbeertjes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E25 Troetelbeertjes: Welkom in Brommelstein
programme.desc: Brombeertje wil graag een dagje rustig aan doen en de wedstrijd op TV kijken. Wanneer hij hierbij gestoord wordt, heeft hij zichzelf niet in de hand en veroorzaakt zijn buikprent een verschrikkelijke storm! Troetelland is veranderd is een land vol chagrijnige beertjes.

programme.title: Troetelbeertjes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 Troetelbeertjes: Dikke Lol Met Brombeer
programme.desc: Op een dag komt er een jongen in een rolstoel, Aiden, naar Troetelland. Zonnebeer heeft zin om met hem te spelen, maar weet niet goed hoe hij moet omgaan met iemand in een rolstoel. Maar Brombeertje laat hem zien dat kinderen in een rolstoel net zo veel plezier kunnen hebben als andere kinderen.

programme.desc: Pieter en zijn vrienden gingen op pad om de zoetste paardebloemen ter wereld te proeven, maar ontdekten dat ze beschermd worden door het gemeenste personage in de hele vallei.

programme.desc: Wanneer Pieter een van de staartveren van Old Brown pakt volgt een wilde achtervolging door de vallei om de veer op te halen en de woedende uil tot bedaren te brengen!

programme.title: Pieter Konijn

programme.desc: Wanneer Jeremy Fisher in de problemen komt tijdens het componeren van een nieuw stuk kunnen alleen Pieter en zijn vrienden hem redden!

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen op het Kasteel

programme.desc: De kasteelheer moet verhuizen omdat zijn geld bijna op is. Achter een schilderij ergens in het kasteel blijkt een geheim gang te zitten. Als Ernst en Bobbie in die gang kruipen, vinden ze iets heel bijzonders.

programme.title: De Smurfen

programme.desc: Moeder Natuur is te druk bezig om een regenboog tevoorschijn te toveren voor het Smurfenfestival, dus Grote Smurf leent haar kookboek en maakt het recept zelf klaar.

programme.title: De Smurfen

programme.desc: De Smurfen leren dat de geest krachtiger is dan materie wanneer ze worden misleid door een oplichter met een belachelijk dure wonderdrank.

programme.title: De Smurfen

programme.desc: Terwijl ze bezig zijn met een missie om het Halloweenfeest van de Smurfen te verstoren, vangen Gargamel en Agatha Luie Smurf die per ongeluk rood is geworden door Moeder Natuur.

programme.title: Mouk

programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa vertellen Popo en Mita hoe ze voor het eerst een wandelende tak hebben gezien in het regenwoud van Venezuela.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa laten hun papieren bootjes racen in een rijstveld in Vietnam. Dat hadden ze beter niet gedaan, want zo komen de rijstvelden bijna droog te staan! Dank zij het meisje Linh Hue leren ze hoe rijst verbouwd wordt.

programme.desc: Vandaag ga ik naar de rode panda’s van DierenPark Amersfoort! We halen bamboe en maken het verblijf klaar voor een nieuwe dag. Ik kijk mee bij de training van de panda’s door dierverzorger Mirthe om hen voor te bereiden op de grote verhuizing.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag

programme.desc: Wat eten de Siberische tijgers van DierenPark Amersfoort! Samen met dierverzorger Marc maak ik het verblijf klaar voor deze dieren. Ik kijk ook mee bij de training van de tijgers, super bijzonder!

programme.desc: Hier in de jungle... leeft Japie ’t Apie met de slang, de papegaai, de tijger en de toekan!

programme.desc: Dit is het droevige verhaal over Smurfin en haar kleine muisje. Een trieste gebeurtenis brengt Smurfin aan het wenen. De andere Smurfen proberen alles om haar te troosten.

programme.desc: Knutselsmurf heeft Klungelsmurf gered van een verschrikkelijk lot. Klungesmurf belooft zijn redder eeuwige toewijding en stelt zich volledig ten zijne dienst….met vervelende gevolgen. Klungels goede bedoelingen moeten gestopt worden voor er nog meer katastrofes gebeuren.

programme.title: Boes
programme.desc: Boes en Dolly gaan met de boot picknicken. Ze rennen achter vlinders aan en plukken bloemen. Als ze honger krijgen, openen ze hun mand. Tot hun verbazing vinden ze een egel in de mand die met alle bananen en boterhammen wegrent.

programme.title: Boes

programme.desc: Boes houdt van honing. Op een dag volgt hij een honingbij en vindt het nest van de bij. Maar helaas is een beer hem te snel af en eet alle honing op! De bij denkt dat Boes zijn honing op heeft gegeten en prikt hem.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E30 Boes: Een huis vol
programme.desc: Als moeder kraai babykonijnen naar haar nest brengt, waar haar kuikens hongerig wachten op eten, vechten de konijnen dapper en winnen. Moeder kraai moet iets anders verzinnen en steelt de lunch van Boes. Boes vraagt zich af wanneer de kraai vegetariër is geworden.

programme.title: Symfollies

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi en Viola wandelen in een boomgaard. Ze willen graag appels plukken, maar kunnen er niet bij. Dan komen Bassoon en Tuba voorbij. O ja, zij zullen hen wel een handje kunnen toesteken! Maar willen de heren dat wel?

programme.title: Symfollies

programme.desc: Bass en Celine slapen nog, en de kinderen gaan al wat in de tuin spelen. De bal belandt pardoes in de ruit van de slaapkamer van de ouders. Stradi en Viola vluchten naar hun kamer. Dan vindt Bass de bal, en…

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Het is een hete zomerdag. Stradi wil graag een ijsje, maar Bass noch Viola willen hem geld geven. Dan komt Horn de boel op stelten zetten, en om zijn fouten goed te maken, tracteert hij het hele gezelschap. Stradi gaat de ijsjes kopen, maar wil zelf het allergrootste…

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi verveelt zich te pletter. Plots ziet hij een luchtballon. Horn wenkt hem voor een tochtje. Terwijl niemand op hem let, stapt hij in. Hoog in de lucht ziet hij sterren en planeten. Hij plukt zelfs een ster uit de hemel.

programme.title: Symfollies

Samen keren ze zich tegen Gargamel en zijn snode plan valt in het water. Grote Smurf slaagt er uiteindelijk ook in om Smurfin een meer smurfse look te geven.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 De Smurfen: De Leerlingsmurf
programme.desc: Klungelsmurf, die populair wil zijn, steelt een van de toverspreuken van Gargamel. Maar het loopt mis en hij verandert in een draak. Het kleine blauwe volkje sluipt samen met Grote Smurf voorzichtig terug naar het kasteel van tovenaar Gargamel. Ze gaan allemaal op zoek naar het tegengif dat Klungelsmurf weer kan omtoveren tot een normaal smurfig wezentje.

programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa reizen door Darjeeling, een bergstreek in India. Daar leren ze hoe thee wordt gekweekt, da’s handig voor de spreekbeurt van Popo en Mita! En zelfs in een klein dorpje vinden ze iemand die hun kapotte computer kan maken.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa vertellen Popo en Mita over het kleurrijke Holi-feest dat ze meemaakten in India.

programme.desc: Vandaag bezoeken wij de stokstaartjes van DierenPark Amersfoort! Dierverzorger Esther maakt verrijking klaar voor de stokstaartjesgroep. Wat eten stokstaartjes en hoe communiceren deze dieren met elkaar?
